hooks.command: f="$(cat | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; d="$(dirname "$f")"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -d "$d/.git" ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; [ -x "$d/bin/lint" ] && "$d/bin/lint" --autofix "$f" || exit 0
